historical_record.description: At the request of the Marina Post of the American Legion, the Recreation Commission resolved that Funston Playground, named for General Frederick Funston, be rededicated on its reopening day, Sunday, June 27, as a living war memorial to the dead of the Second World War.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for concrete bleachers at Funston Playground, designed by Charles F. Strothoff, to Morris Daley at $169,650.

The Commission received a letter of thanks from the Garrigan family for the dedication of the Edward P. Garrigan Field, the baseball diamond at Funston Playground, whose plaque the Commission had approved in February (Resolution 4706), subject to the Art Commission.
